verdict.rationale: Residency control is only implied: the data plane can be self-hosted or on-prem (Docker, local log paths), and the hybrid-mode control plane stays out of the data path and by default doesn't see LLM/MCP traffic. That suggests payloads stay in infrastructure the user chooses. However, no evidence documents explicit region or data-residency selection. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the Konnect control plane and analytics/log storage, a documented data-residency policy, and independent corroboration.
